# ShermLabs Memory

Research software prototype for organizing papers, reviewing PDF text extraction, tracking provenance and revisions, and asking questions over selected source evidence.

Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jfF6JErASs
Website: https://shermrecords.github.io/shermlabs_memory-site/
Source: https://github.com/shermrecords/shermlabs_memory

The demo uses manually checked abstract passages, keyword retrieval, and AI-selected exact source quotations. It does not demonstrate full-paper validated synthesis. Outputs require researcher review.
